headline: Election of new corporation and trustee members, and a bylaw update for The Lyceum.
summary: The agenda also includes the FY2025 annual financial report, a library director's report, and the Mary M. Weissblum Volunteer Award. Geoff Bradford and John Day are up for reelection to new terms.
items: Welcome on behalf of the Library
Welcome on behalf of the City
Election of eight new members of the Corporation
Election of four new members of the Board of Trustees
Reelection of Geoff Bradford (second term) and John Day (third term)
Election of Cheryl Marks as Vice President of the Board of Trustees
location: Community Room, Sawyer Free Library, 2 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
